text:
Maya: Heads-up — HW partner (EdgeWave) says some of their devices aren’t showing usage in our marketplace for the 03/18 window. they see heartbeats in their logs but our ingest shows gaps.
Tomas: Oof. do we have a quick sample of the partner payload?
Maya: pasted one below from their support ticket: 
```json
{
  "device_id": "EW-az-1932",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T14:12:03Z",
  "usage_seconds": 360,
  "signature": "sig_v1_xxx"
}
```
Maya: They claim we accepted the webhook (200) but later our meter-rollup didn’t include it.
Jin: Possible causes: delayed ingestion, TTL expiry in the partner buffer, or our idempotency dedupe dropping it.
Sasha: @tomas can you check the broker logs for that device_id around 14:12 UTC? filter on `EW-az-1932` and `signature:sig_v1_xxx`.
Tomas: On it, pulling logs now. :mag: 
ops-bot: deploy-service/ws-ingest v2.14 promoted to canary on eu-west-1 by ci/cd at 2026-03-18T13:50Z
Tomas: Found the POST hitting the edge gateway at 14:12:04 and forwarded to kafka partition-7. consumer offset shows message consumed at 14:12:45 by partner-usage-ingest.
Tomas: But partner-usage-ingest emitted a NACK to the dedupe queue due to `duplicate_signature` rule at 14:13:01.
Maya: Why would signature be duplicate? partner says it generated once. maybe replay from their retry logic?
Jin: Two possibilities: partner retried after timeout, or our signature-hash collision across different events (unlikely). can we surface the raw payloads for both events?
Sasha: I pulled two payloads: one at 14:12:03 and another at 14:12:59. both signatures identical, payload identical except `timestamp`. partner side says they retried after 50s because they didn't get a 2xx within 30s (intermittent network).
Maya: That explains dedupe but we should still count one of them into rollups. why did rollup ignore both?
Jin: Looking at the rollup job: it skips records that arrived after the `ingest_cutoff` (14:00 UTC for that hourly batch) unless they have `late=true` flag. buffer policy says 30m grace window. their second retry arrived within 1m so fine. but I see an ingestion marker: when dedupe NACK returns, we mark event as `rejected_for_dedup` and never flag `accepted` even if earlier attempt succeeded. bug.
Maya: So duplicate signature handling incorrectly suppresses the accepted state.
Tomas: Proposed fix: when dedupe NACK happens, check if there was an earlier `accepted` on the same signature (by message_id) and reconcile status to `accepted`. minimal fix can be a reconciliation job that runs hourly and flips `rejected_for_dedup` to `accepted` if a matching accepted event exists.
Sasha: +1 on reconciliation job. we should also extend the grace window to 45m for partners with flaky networks — ops config is per-partner.
Maya: Partner asks for an ETA to restore their missing usage (they've got finance runs tomorrow). can we backfill?
Jin: We can run a targeted backfill for the 03/18 14:00-15:00 hour for their partner_id. steps: 1) extract raw events from kafka (partition-7, offsets 12345-12390) 2) dedupe with corrected logic 3) re-run hourly rollup for that hour. estimate ~2h including verification.
Tomas: I can run step 1 and 2 now if we lock the window to avoid racing ingest. recommend a short ingest freeze for that partner (toggle in Partner Portal).
Maya: I'll ask partner to accept a 15-minute ingestion freeze. pinging them now. @jin @tomas keep me posted on runbook. :pray:
Sasha: Also PR to add an observability metric: `dedupe.rejections_by_partner` and a dashboard. want this quick.
ops-bot: incident-tracker created INC-2026-311: "EdgeWave missing usage — dedupe state bug" assigned to eng-plat
Jin: Adding unit tests for the dedupe state machine. will open PR after reproducer.
Tomas: 14:35 UTC — I pulled offsets and started the recon job. will update progress in this thread.
Maya: Thanks team. After backfill we'll send partner a CSV with reconciled lines and a short note on the fix/next steps.
Partner Rep (via email relay): thanks, appreciate the quick response — need CSV for finance by EOD.
Maya: Aiming to close by 16:30 UTC. I'll post the CSV here once done.
Tomas: 14:55 UTC — recon job completed, 27 events inserted into hourly rollup, totals now match partner. attaching proof of counts: `partner_total_before=0`, `after=27`.
Maya: Great. I'll draft the response and attach CSV. closing loop after partner confirms. :white_check_mark:
